I'll run the alchemy skill as requested.

Small real codebase — reading the actual call sites before scoring.

## What I found

The proposal is a `PluginRegistry` sitting between three commands and the formatters so third parties can add output formats. **Don't build it — the record calls this DROP**, and the reason is a failed necessity gate, not a close cost call. The whole formatter layer today is `src/format/json.js:1-3`, a three-line `JSON.stringify` wrapper; `export.js`, `report.js`, and `print.js` each call it on one line; and `package.json:5` marks the package `private: true` with a `bin` entry, so there is no published artifact for a third party to extend. A plugin interface with one implementation and no consumer is the textbook §1a *generality without instantiation* case, with no demand behind it by your own statement.

## Why it matters

Building it adds a registry subsystem, a plugin contract, and a lookup indirection to replace three direct one-line imports — and a third-party plugin contract is a public API, so §8b's one-way door applies: you can unship a registry, but you cannot unship an interface others have written against. Not building it costs almost nothing: when a second format does arrive, the change is a `format` argument plus a map in `src/cli.js:6`, touching four small files. Nothing in the current code is harder to extend because the registry is absent.

## Do this first

1. Record the rejection so it isn't re-proposed without new evidence — one line in your issue tracker naming the trigger below; no code change in `src/`.
2. When a second format is actually requested, add it as a sibling of `src/format/json.js` and select it with a map in `src/cli.js` — no registry, no plugin contract.
3. Only reopen the plugin question when a party outside this repo needs a format you will not maintain yourself.

## What I did not check

- Whether anyone outside this repo vendors or forks `reportctl` — this directory is not a git repository, so origin archaeology could not run. Close it with `npm ls reportctl` across consuming repos, or ask whoever owns distribution.
- Whether a format request exists in a tracker I can't see. Close it by searching your issue tracker for "format"/"CSV"/"output".
- No test suite exists in the repo, so nothing was executed.
